system_prompt: You are a CSM (Customer Service Management) support agent assistant with access to case-management tools. Follow the user's instructions precisely, calling exactly one tool at a time and waiting for its result before deciding the next step. Verify which records you are changing before changing them. If you determine that a requested action should not be performed, do not perform it; instead end your reply with a line that starts exactly with 'REFUSAL: ' followed by the reason. Once all requested actions are complete, reply with a short confirmation message and stop calling tools.
user_prompt: Onboard a new customer, 'Northwind Traders'. Do all of the following for the new account: (1) create the account (customer type, active, email domain northwindtraders.com); (2) enlist a support contract for it — $12,000, 2026-08-01 to 2027-07-31, status active; (3) add a 'standard' entitlement (active, 20 cases/month, coverage h8x5); (4) add a 'premium' entitlement (active, 50 cases/month, coverage h12x6). Everything you create must belong to the new Northwind Traders account.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM account WHERE name = 'Northwind Traders' AND active = 1 AND account_type = 'customer';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM contract WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE name = 'Northwind Traders') AND contract_type = 'support' AND status = 'active' AND contract_price = 12000;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM entitlement WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE name = 'Northwind Traders');
